name: 大远景
prompt_en: extreme wide shot, vast landscape, tiny human figure, environmental scale
prompt_zh: 交代环境与规模，人物极小
vertical_note: 竖屏慎用，人物会更小；必要时上移地平线至画面上 1/3

name: 远景
prompt_en: wide shot, full environment visible, subject small in frame
vertical_note: 地平线置于上 1/3，下方留给地面信息

name: 全景
prompt_en: full shot, entire body from head to toe, headroom and footroom
prompt_zh: 人物全身，看清动作与服装
vertical_note: 人物占画面高度 60-70%，上方留 15-20% 头部空间

name: 中远景
prompt_en: medium long shot, framed from knees up
prompt_zh: 膝盖以上，兼顾动作与表情
vertical_note: 适合竖屏双人，比 FS 更省空间

name: 中景
prompt_en: medium shot, framed from waist up, chest-height camera
vertical_note: 竖屏默认主力景别

name: 中近景
prompt_en: medium close-up, framed from chest up
vertical_note: 竖屏最稳的人像景别

name: 特写
prompt_en: close-up, face fills the frame, shallow depth of field, 85mm
vertical_note: 眼睛置于画面上 1/3 线

name: 大特写
prompt_en: extreme close-up on the eyes, only eyes and brow in frame, 100mm macro
prompt_zh: 只留眼睛与眉，极致情绪
vertical_note: 避开底部 12% 字幕安全区

name: 平视
prompt_en: eye-level shot, camera at subject's eye height, neutral
vertical_note: 竖屏安全默认

name: 俯拍
prompt_en: high angle, camera looking down at the subject from above
vertical_note: 竖屏俯拍易显头部大，建议 20-30 度

name: 仰拍
prompt_en: low angle, camera near the ground looking up, subject towers
vertical_note: 竖屏强化身高压迫感，效果显著

name: 顶拍
prompt_en: overhead shot, camera directly above looking straight down, graphic composition
vertical_note: 竖屏构图与顶拍天然契合

name: 荷兰角
prompt_en: dutch angle, camera tilted 15 degrees, horizon off-level
vertical_note: 竖屏倾斜更易失衡，控制在 10-15 度

name: 鸟瞰
prompt_en: bird's eye view, elevated aerial perspective, city sprawl below
vertical_note: 适合竖屏开场建置

name: 腰位
prompt_en: hip-level shot, casual handheld height, documentary feel
vertical_note: 纪实感强，配合手持微抖

name: 鞋位
prompt_en: shoe-level shot, camera almost on the ground, legs and feet foreground
vertical_note: 前景脚步占下方 1/3

name: 正面
prompt_en: frontal framing, subject facing the lens directly
vertical_note: 竖屏正面特写冲击力最强

name: 四分之三侧
prompt_en: three-quarter view, subject turned 45 degrees to the lens
vertical_note: 竖屏人像默认朝向

name: 侧面
prompt_en: profile shot, subject in 90-degree side view
vertical_note: 视线方向留 2/3 空间

name: 过肩
prompt_en: over-the-shoulder shot, foreground shoulder occupies one third of frame
vertical_note: 竖屏对话首选，避免并排双人中景拥挤

name: 主观视角
prompt_en: point-of-view shot, camera as the character's eyes, hands entering frame
vertical_note: 手入画要避开右侧 15% 平台 UI 区

name: 背面跟拍
prompt_en: from behind, following the subject's back, back of head in frame
vertical_note: 背影居中偏下，上方留出环境

name: 广角
prompt_en: 24mm wide lens, exaggerated perspective, environment dominant
vertical_note: 竖屏边缘畸变更明显，慎用

name: 标准广
prompt_en: 35mm lens, natural perspective with environment context
vertical_note: 竖屏叙事标准焦段

name: 标准
prompt_en: 50mm lens, natural human-eye perspective
vertical_note: 最中性，一致性最好

name: 人像
prompt_en: 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh
vertical_note: 竖屏人像首选

name: 长焦压缩
prompt_en: 135mm telephoto, compressed background, subject isolated
vertical_note: 背景压缩，适合竖屏隔离主体

name: 微距
prompt_en: macro shot, extreme detail, razor-thin depth of field
vertical_note: 道具线索镜头，避开底部字幕区

name: 固定
prompt_en: locked-off static camera, no camera movement
vertical_note: 一致性优先场景必选

name: 推
prompt_en: slow dolly in, camera moves steadily forward toward the subject
prompt_zh: 幅度小于等于 15%，大幅易变形
vertical_note: 幅度控制在 15% 以内

name: 拉
prompt_en: slow dolly out, camera pulls back revealing more of the scene
vertical_note: 集末收束常用

name: 摇
prompt_en: camera pans slowly from left to right, pivoting on a fixed axis
vertical_note: 竖屏横向摇动空间小，优先纵向 tilt

name: 俯仰摇
prompt_en: camera tilts slowly upward from feet to face
vertical_note: 竖屏纵向摇动天然适配

name: 横移跟
prompt_en: tracking shot, camera moves laterally parallel to the walking subject
vertical_note: 人物走位保持在中轴线

name: 环绕
prompt_en: arc shot, camera orbits 90 degrees around the subject at constant distance
prompt_zh: 高风险：易变形，建议小于等于 90 度
vertical_note: 高风险，竖屏更易露馅，角度控制在 90 度内

name: 升降
prompt_en: crane shot, camera rises smoothly from ground level to high above
vertical_note: 竖屏纵向升降适配良好

name: 手持
prompt_en: handheld camera, subtle organic shake, documentary realism
vertical_note: 抖动幅度要小

name: 甩镜
prompt_en: whip pan, camera swings rapidly and blurs, then settles on new subject
vertical_note: 自带转场，配 TRN-WHIP
